Question: Is Madonna too old to be making the kind of music she makes?
Answer: Why in the hell not? Madonna is one of those singers who are able to reinvent themselves with ease every couple of years or so. Sure, you have critics who lament that “she’s too old to be making that kind of music”. But age is just a number - there isn’t any law out there they once you turn a certain age, you are to only restrict yourself to making solemn religious hymns, is there? Should Aerosmith and The Stones now change too? I don’t think I’m up to seeing them make only funeral music now either, and just like that, I’m not ready to see Madonna being forced to make “age appropriate” music. Let her make the music she wants to - if someone doesn’t like it, it’s their choice and honestly their loss. She is still an amazing musician, and apart from her looking older, her music is still pretty damn good! I don’t think her age has anything to do with her music quality.

Question: Why does Disha Patani always wear bikinis?
Answer: She does not always wear bikinis - but she does when she’s doing ad campaigns or on a beach or the ocean or some such place. It is disingenuous to claim that she is always wearing bikinis. You may feel like that because you only seek out images of her in bikinis. But take a deeper dive into her profile, and you’ll find plenty of non-bikini images. Yes, you’ll find plenty of bikini images too, but what of it? She looks great in them, and is super comfortable with them.

Answer: Since, there does not appear to be any top Pakistani actress named Rekha, I would say that a sum total of zero Indian actors have worked with Rekha. Question: What was the Lars Von Trier movie that managed to excite a lot of people?
Answer: Well, the answer to this question is possibly the duology of the two Nymphomaniac movies. Actually, scratch that - I think the Lars von Trier movie that managed to excite a lot of people is the first movie in the duology. I refer to Nymphomaniac: Vol 1. After people saw the movie, and realized that all of the sex in the movie was far, far, and did I say far, away from being sexy, I bet the excitement died out for the next movie. The titillation quotient of both these movies is absurdly low. The movies are both rather disturbing, as most Lars von Trier movies tend to be. So, I would say that people got excited about the Nymphomaniac duology, due to all the rampant sex promised in it. Many were probably expecting some sort of auteurish homage to Ron Jeremy or John Holmes’ movies - what they got instead was a disturbing tragedy, with lots of extremely clinical looking sex. That sort of stuff rarely excites anyone - if someone got excited by either of the Nymphomaniac movies, then well, they are obviously individuals with exceedingly great libidinous fortitude. Question: Can I add meat in Vada Pav?
Answer: You most certainly can, but then your dish will not be Vada Pav any longer. Depending on how you make it, it’ll either transform into Bun Kabab or will be Keema Pav. If you change the bread or the pav, then you’ll have a regular Burger or even a Sloppy Joe sandwich. Anyway, however you dice it and slice it, in the end, it’s worth it if you enjoy the dish. So, go right ahead, and create/innovate etc. Just note that if you do make Vada Pav with meat, it just won’t be authentic Vada Pav anymore. The whole point of Vada Pav is that it’s a Potato Vada inside a Pav, with some chutney and a lovely green chilly. It is meant to be a vegetarian dish, adding meat to it changes it entirely.
